raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fix multi-turn speculative TPOT bubbles on Ascend when chunked prefill is disabled and scheduling is prefill-first (Ascend/sglang #1093).

- While speculative decoding is on, mixed chunk is off, and a decode batch is running, skip new prefills **and** in-flight `chunked_req` continuations so decode is not starved.
- If `--chunked-prefill-size` is unset or `<= 0` under EAGLE/NEXTN, default it to **1024**. An explicit positive value is unchanged.

## NPU retest (Qwen3-Next W8A8 + NEXTN, C=2, generated-shared-prefix)

Formal baseline before the fix: Mean TPOT delta **-22.82** (fail), Max ITL about 4s.

Adopted scheme (decode-prefer + chunked 1024), 10/10 runs with |delta| <= 1 ms (max |delta| 0.92):

| Run | A | B | delta |
|-----|---|---|-------|
| 1 | 14.56 | 15.39 | +0.83 |
| 2 | 15.40 | 15.17 | -0.23 |
| 3 | 15.03 | 15.20 | +0.17 |
| 4 | 15.23 | 15.19 | -0.04 |
| 5 | 14.76 | 15.07 | +0.31 |
| 6 | 15.53 | 15.21 | -0.32 |
| 7 | 15.26 | 15.04 | -0.22 |
| 8 | 14.16 | 15.05 | +0.89 |
| 9 | 16.25 | 15.33 | -0.92 |
| 10 | 15.02 | 15.49 | +0.47 |

V2 + chunked 2048 was only 8/10, so 1024 is the default.

## Related

- https://github.com/Ascend/sglang/issues/1093

## Test plan

- [x] 10x A/B bench on Atlas 800T A2, |Mean TPOT delta| <= 1 ms
- [ ] Upstream CI

         )
 
+    # SGLANG_1093_CHUNKED_PREFILL_DEFAULT
+    # Disabled chunked prefill under EAGLE/NEXTN lets one exclusive prefill
+    # starve decode and blows multi-turn TPOT. Default to 1024; an explicit
+    # positive --chunked-prefill-size is left unchanged.
+    _cps = cfg.chunked_prefill_size
+    if _cps is None or _cps <= 0:
+        declare_resolution(
+            server_args,
+            "_handle_eagle_family",
+            chunked_prefill_size=1024,
+        )
+        logger.warning(
+            "chunked_prefill_size was disabled (%s); reset to 1024 for "
+            "EAGLE/NEXTN speculative decoding to reduce multi-turn TPOT "
+            "bubbles. Override with an explicit positive --chunked-prefill-size.",
+            _cps,
+        )
